_comment: Public hosts fleet-gate allows in https:// URLs for the mil-host (added lines) and endpoints (full repo) checks. A host matches an entry exactly or as a subdomain of it. Docs (.md/.txt/.html under docs or README) are IGNORED; anywhere else a match is a WARN, because runtime calls must still degrade gracefully offline (CANES may be disconnected). Bare hosts, http://, userinfo (user@host) and secret-looking query parameters keep the original FAIL. Every entry needs why and approvedBy.

hosts.why: Public Navy news/press pages cited in docs (NAVWAR, CHIPS)
